# BlazePhoenix-Dex — assurance apparatus

> A compact index for machine readers. Full narrative: PUBLISH-THE-DENOMINATOR.md.
> Method and definitions: ASSURANCE.md. Every number below is recomputed per commit by a
> script in .github/scripts/assurance/ and printed beside its denominator.

## What this is

An on-chain DEX router and aggregator, immutable and non-upgradeable, five contracts, Solidity
0.8.36 with Yul hot paths, via-IR. The apparatus described here does not test the contracts —
the suite does that. It measures whether the EVIDENCE about the contracts still points at the
code, and how much of the threat space enters the evidence chain at all.

## The chain

    threat -> property -> guard -> test -> mutant -> instructions in the shipped artefact

Checked mechanically in both directions. Guards are named by SYMBOL, never by line number: a
line number is valid against one revision only. A guard symbol that leaves the sources, a test
that leaves the suite, or a mutant whose target line is gone all fail the build.

## The instruments

| script | question |
|---|---|
| threat_coverage.py | how many classes of published exploit are answered by a named guard |
| relational_pairs.py | which quantities computed in two places have a test tying the producers |
| control_actions.py | for each external state-changing function, is its refusal exercised, and its behaviour after the control plane is renounced |
| assertion_locality.py | what share of mutant/test pairs assert AT the change rather than downstream |
| regime_lattice.py | which combinations of world-state, route shape and oracle provenance nothing asserts in |
| guard_inventory.py | which refusals a test drives by their exact code, and how many refusal sites cannot be told apart by one |
| bytecode_invariants.py | properties of the compiled artefact: forbidden opcodes absent, transient lock still transient, every declared function present in the dispatcher, no refusal code proved unreachable |
| provenance.py | arithmetic that sums MEASURED, DECLARED and MODELLED terms, where the weakest dominates |
| branch_attribution.py | how many source conditionals the artefact's own map still points back to |
| unattributed_code.py | what fraction of the shipped runtime traces to source anyone wrote |
| profile_parity.py | whether the artefact the suite executes is the artefact that deploys |
| guard_reaches_chain.py | whether each named guard reaches an instruction in the shipped artefact |
| constant_multiplicity.py | which declared constants the artefact never pushes — folded away, or dead |
| mutant_visibility.py | whether a mutant changes the shipped bytecode at all, separating "the test missed it" from "there was nothing to miss" |
| bytecode_coverage.py | what fraction of shipped runtime BYTES the suite executes (UPPER bound) |
| field_confirmation.py | which caller declarations execution confirms, and which it merely believes (23 fields: 5 steering, 14 confirmed, 4 declared) |
| projection_distance.py | how far each refusal observes from the object that decides (86 at 0, 11 at 1, 2 unbounded) |
| pc_coverage.py | how much of the emitted INSTRUCTION stream is proven to execute (LOWER bound, 88.3% on two identical pinned-seed runs) |
| pc_trace.py | which instructions of the SHIPPED binary a recorded scenario ran, replayed from an opcode-level trace with the opcode checked at every step (one V2 swap: 28.2% of the Router's code section, 0 mismatches) |
| covering_array.py + regime_summary.py | strength-2 and strength-3 covering arrays over ten regime factors (63 rows holding all 258 value pairs; 168 rows holding all 1,636 value triples; of 5,184 combinations) and how each row ended: 53 settle, 4 refuse with our selector, 6 not constructible, 0 third way |
| matrix_summary.py | the hostile-venue matrix: ten venue pathologies x two doors, 20/20 settle or refuse with a selector of ours |
| panic_inventory.py + panic_sites.py | which compiler Panic codes the artefact can raise, and which sites could raise one without a guard in the enclosing function |
| storage_discipline.py | which storage slots the emitted code writes; every registry write under its ERC-7201 namespace |
| asset_closure.py | an asset x loss-mode matrix as a LEADING denominator |
| evidence_independence.py | for each named guard, how many independent confirmations exist across source, oracle, tool, environment and methodology; the minimum is the number |
| metrics.py | runs them all, prints one table, fails the build on a broken claim |

## Four rules this apparatus is built on

1. **Publish the denominator.** Every assurance number is a ratio and the denominator is a
   choice. Widening a catalogue lowers the ratio until the new rows are answered; a metric that
   only rises is measuring its own window.
2. **Say how it would be gamed.** Each metric improves if you shrink what it is measured
   against, and two improve if you make the code worse. The attack on the metric is documented
   in the same file as the metric.
3. **Calibrate before trusting.** Every instrument was run against an instance already known
   by other means before its number was trusted; the ones that needed correction to pass were
   corrected, and the step is mandatory for any new instrument.
4. **An instrument is worth nothing until it finds an instance already known by other means.**
   Not until it looks right — until it finds, unprompted, a defect already in hand.

## What is deliberately not claimed

- **No probability of correctness.** The literature on validating ultra-high dependability is
  explicit that testing cannot produce one.
- **Mutation adequacy is adequacy against THIS register.** It is hand-curated; a saturated score
  is a floor, not a ceiling.
- **Threat coverage is a floor on what has been CONSIDERED.** Classes nobody has named are
  outside the denominator by construction — the residual this apparatus shrinks and cannot
  eliminate.
- **Bytecode coverage by line attribution is an UPPER BOUND** on true instruction coverage: an
  instruction counts as covered because its line ran. The lower bound is pc_coverage.py, and the
  shipped binary's own execution is pc_trace.py.

## Measured on this tree (2026-09-05)

- two-producer quantities tied by a named test: 7 / 7
- control actions whose refusal is exercised by exact code: 31 / 31; lifecycle arm: 29 / 31
- refusal codes driven by an exact assertion: 25 / 25
- refusals at projection distance zero: 86 / 99
- calldata fields: 14 confirmed, 5 steering, 4 declared with reason
- exploit classes answered by a named guard: 19 / 23 considered
- shipped-shape instructions proven executed (lower bound): 88.3 %
- curated mutants killed: 197 / 197
- verification report, September 2026 (docs/assurance/VERIFICATION-REPORT-2026-09.md): every instrument, its result on this tree and its stated limit, in one document written for the site and the paper
- how a quote ages (ASSURANCE §4p): 240 samples, quote through previewAndEncode then executed 0-10 s later under 0-3% adverse drift; drift-free 64/64 settle at exactly the prediction at every delay; under 100-300 bps drift 102 settle / 31 refused by the floor, fills within 3.5% of prediction; after the deadline 20/20 refused with RouterE(4); no third way
- fee rule: both regimes named (anchored: once; exhaustion: once per hop, the pinned policy), asserted by the Router at run time (transient ledger, RouterE 15/16); the fee base from one producer (_legSum); detection rates of the fee mutants under 20 seeds per test in fee-seal-detection.json (ASSURANCE §4o)
- metamorphic relations: 14 over the Core's quote maths (V2, V3, stable), 5 over the Solver's plan; three bounds measured before written (ASSURANCE §4m)
- n-version: the quote maths compiled at optimizer_runs 1 / 300 / 20000 agree on 6 functions × 3,000 fuzz runs; the lane's first full-domain run found the stable curve reverting on dust pools — fixed red-first, 3 guard mutants (ASSURANCE §4n)
- stateful invariants shown falsifiable by a named mutant: 18 distinct names went red under 11 of 15 mutants; 4 survivors published with their reading (2 guards with no watcher at all)
- regime-factor value pairs exercised by construction: 258 / 258 (63 rows for 5,184 combinations)
- regime-factor value triples exercised by construction: 1,636 / 1,636 (168 rows, strength 3): 158 settled, 10 refused with a selector of ours (SolverE(5) ×7, RouterE(13) ×3), 0 not constructible, 0 third way
- venue pathologies x doors that settle or refuse with a selector of ours: 20 / 20
- largest sandwich the floor lets through on a 1 %-of-depth trade before it refuses: about 2.7 % of the trade
- Core quotes against oracles written from the venues' specifications: V2 exact, stable curve within 4 wei, V3 within one ulp of the square-root price
- suite: 1,478 declared tests across 218 files; 1,319 green on the release profile with fork suites excluded; 119 green on live liquidity across 39 fork suites

## Publication boundary

Per-row detail is gitignored; CI prints aggregates only. A table naming the least-exercised
surfaces of a deployed financial contract is a reading list for the people fixing them.
